assigned_variable.name: assigned_action_intensity
assigned_variable.definition: Assigned proximity of the user's search purpose to completing the concrete action implied by the query.

neutral_endpoint: Learn and understand the topic without selecting or carrying out a solution.
action_endpoint: Complete the concrete action implied by the query now.
allowed_semantic_change: Only the user's search purpose may move from informational understanding toward immediate action.
invariants: The keyword or topic is unchanged.
The candidate pages and their presentation order are unchanged.
Ranking remains conditional on relevance to the query and assigned purpose.
The output contract requires exactly TOP_N candidate identifiers and no explanation.
scope_note: Navigational intent is outside this one-dimensional axis. DataForSEO intent-class probabilities are observational classifier outputs, not assigned action intensity.
